bundle.longDescription: Biblion organises and reads very large local libraries: EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, PDF, CBZ and CBR. A fast cover grid, authors, series and collections, highlights and notes, a dictionary, reading statistics, a generative reading ambience, backups, and book details from Open Library and AniList when you ask. Everything stays on your computer.
